roundTwoFindings.note: An unselected chip presses to --handle #dce0d4 (measured on Dock tail); the selected chip keeps paper; the demo presses chip 2.

The check is rendered only on the selected chip and unselected labels are centred, but the width is not stable: selecting Iron grows it 82->101px and All shrinks 83->63px, shifting every chip after it. The README claims the width stays the same.
Chip-specific rules: 1-2 word job names, 12/6 character cap, one count, All first without a count, the dynamic set scrolls.
variants/tags.html drops All's count; the Overview preview on the atlas page still shows All 2 beside Iron 3 / Dock tail 4.

checklist.why: Purpose plus 'use Segment instead for fixed views and list states'.
Scroll track, chip, label, count, check, reason named and shown.
One variant (tags), used by Piglet processing's pen list.
Pressed visible on unselected chips; the selected chip keeps its face.
Chips 48px tall, narrowest 63px at 390; token gap.
No cap by design; the dynamic set scrolls.
Selected = check + weight + paper face; disabled = dashed outline + reason.
Own chip content rules now; the Chinese long label renders without clipping.
Links Segment, ChoiceList, IconButton; TaskChips adapter; classified component.
Six states at 375; only intentional horizontal scroll.

variants.name: tags (single-select job filter with counts)
findings: Selecting a chip changes its width by about 19px (check + gap), so the scroll track reflows under the finger.

findings.text: Width is not stable on select: the padding that reserves the check stays on the selected chip too, so it grows by the check width (Iron 82->101, All 83->63 at 390), contradicting the README.
findings.fix: Give the selected chip the plain padding: .st-filter-chips button[aria-checked=true]{padding-inline:var(--space-row-x)}.

findings.text: The atlas Overview preview still shows All with a count (All 2 beside Iron 3), against the new 'All has no count' rule; only variants/tags.html was updated.
findings.fix: Drop All's count in FilterChips/preview.html as in variants/tags.html.
